html:
<header><ng-content select="cs-topbar,[csTopbar]" /></header>
<aside [class.open]="opened()"><ng-content select="cs-sidenav,[csSidenav]" /></aside>

}
<main><ng-content /></main>
<ng-content select="cs-bottom-nav" />
